{{Quote|Legions of Shadow! Hear the word of your Lord! If this Jedi pup can defeat the Lord of the Shadow Throne, you will be his! Obey his every word as you would my own! Thus is the command of Shadowspawn!|Nick Rostu under the control of Cronal|<ref name="SOM" />}}
The '''Legions of Shadow''' was a splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] led by the [[Lord of the Shadow Throne]], [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]], previously known as [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Blackhole]] or [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Cronal. They were vanquished by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] at the [[Battle of Mindor]] [[5 ABY/Legends|six months]] after the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destruction]].<ref name="SOM" />

==History==

===Inception===
[[File:Cronal TERC.jpg|thumb|left|Lord Cronal created the Legions of Shadow to give himself a new and younger body to replace his withering one.]]
Cronal created the Legions of Shadow as part of his grand plan to take over [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] body. He created [[Holothriller|holothrillers]], such as ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge]]'', to make it seem as if Palpatine had chosen Luke to be his successor on the Imperial Throne. This was so Cronal could take over his body and still have forces at his disposal so he could bring about his grand plan of ensuring everything in the galaxy would be destroyed and die out, alongside having a new, stronger body to replace his withering decrepit current one which was failing to him such an extent that he couldn't stand, feed himself, or breathe without a life-support chamber. He referred to this as the [[Great Cause (Shadowspawn)|Great Cause]].<ref name="SOM" />

===Rumors of a second coming===
{{Quote|And this is what I ask of you, Wing Commander. That you join me in my quest to fulfill the dying wish of our Beloved Emperor: to heal the broken heart of the son of the last true Jedi hero, and to put Luke Skywalker, Palpatine's chosen heir, in his rightful place as the absolute ruler of our Galactic Empire|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="SOM" />}}
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] rumors began to spread throughout Imperial regions of a mysterious new leader with both the cunning and charisma of a second coming of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kraven]] had sent then [[Wing Commander/Legends|wing commander]] [[Klick (clone trooper)/Legends|Klick]] to eradicate Shadowspawn, but instead of resisting, Shadowspawn welcomed him with open arms. Even greeting him with an array of authentic command codes, even Palpatine's secret codes for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone Troopers]], of which Klick was among. Shadowspawn claimed to be handpicked by Palpatine to hold the throne in trust for Palpatine's chosen heir. He explained Palpatine had given him the clones codes to prove his authenticity to them, and prove he was their temporary ruler.<ref name="SOM" />

Shadowspawn explained to Klick the story of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and how Palpatine had saved him, and showed him his holothriller, ''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge'', when the fateful encounter on the second Death Star came, Palpatine expressed his love for Anakin Skywalker to Luke Skywalker, and how much he would wanted Luke to take the throne. According to Shadowspawn, this made Vader snap and he struck down Palpatine, as he hoped to take the throne himself, and realised that he was always going to be second fiddle to Skywalker when it came to the next in line. According to Shadowspawn, Luke was so shocked that he couldn't act in time to save Palpatine, and so he murdered Vader and returned to the Rebels as he felt his guilt and grief at failing to save the Emperor made him no better than them, thinking that he deserved to be another outlaw among thieves, pirates and murderers like the Rebellion. Klick knew the holothriller was an exaggerated, dramatized version of events, but felt it so real. Shadowspawn explained it was his goal to bring Luke Skywalker back, heal his heart, and have him lay claim to the Imperial Throne, as was Palpatine's wishes. Klick was proud to surrender his forces to the cause and even hoped to one day kneel before Skywalker. As he joined the Legions of Shadow, Shadowspawn promoted him to [[Group Captain]] and command of his own fighter group.<ref name="SOM" />

===The raids and trap===
[[File:Rogue Squadron.svg|thumb|right|Rogue Squadron lured Group Captain Klick and his men into a trap.]]
Over the course of the six months following the Battle of Endor, the Legions of Shadow raided New Republic territories, leaving just enough destruction and looting to camouflage the real thing, which was to write off the people who "perished" in the attacks as dead, when in reality they captured to be potential recruits for the [[Pawn|Pawns]]. These raids shook peoples perception on the New Republic, making them ask questions about the New Republic's ability to maintain order and security.<ref name="SOM" />

Eventually, however, a New Republic agent "leaked" the course of the [[Corellian Queen|''Corellian Queen'']], to which Klick's fighter group went after, only to find that the Corellian Queen was not present at all and was instead a trap set up by the New Republic. With specialized torpedo's, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was able to track Klicks fighter group back to their base of [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], a planet in the [[Taspan system]].<ref name="SOM" />

===Battle of Mindor===
{{Quote|Unidentified Rebel command cruiser, I am Lord Shadowspawn. You have defeated us. I respectfully request permission to board, that I may formally treat for the lives of my men.|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="SOM" />}}{{Main|Battle of Mindor}}
When reported by Klick that New Republic forces were on their way, Shadowspawn instructed Klick to keep their forces grounded and let them win, hoping to bring Luke Skywalker. Shadowspawn's plan was successful, causing everything to go to suspiciously according to plan for the New Republic, only for Shadowspawn to call for a truce and then send a [[Gravity slice|g-slice]] that cut up the ''[[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|Justice]]'' into three parts. Luke Skywalker was able to land of the bridge of the ''Justice'' on base planet of the Legion of Shadow, [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], and after his crew went missing he lured Shadowspawn's legions to himself, asking to be taken to Shadowspawn himself.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:Battle_of_Mindor.jpg|thumb|left|Luke fought "Lord Shadowspawn" only to learn he was actually Nick Rostu.]]
Luke was brought before "Shadowspawn" in the [[Cavern of the Shadow Throne]], to which "Shadowspawn" explained that if Luke killed him, the [[Shadow Throne]] would be his and his forces would obey his every command. "Shadowspawn" forced a duel with his [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] imbued [[Shadowspawn's sword|sword]] against [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|Luke's lightsaber]]. Luke found him to be clumsy, describing him as having heard of swordplay but never seeing it. He was soon after was able to rip off the headgear of "Shadowspawn" to reveal it wasn't Shadowspawn at all, and instead one of his Pawns, [[Nick Rostu]]. Luke called for two of Shadowspawn's Blackhole stormtroopers to assist Rostu, but real Shadowspawn, though absent in the room, began to mold the meltmassif stone, emptying the vault of it, and using an energy bolt to knock Luke unconscious.<ref name="SOM" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] arrived late to the battle, and were on Mindor's surface in search of Luke. They met [[Aeona Cantor]] and her fellow [[Mindorese]] before being ambushed by the Legions of Shadow. Han, Leia, and Chewie attempted to flee in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], however, Leia was able to encourage Han to go back for the Mindorese. Doing so, they got the Mindorese and took shelter in the caves of a large canyon. Aeona winded up swapping blasters with Han, and Leia noticed [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] with the Mindorese, R2 having been with Luke when the Justice went down. R2 attempted to warn Leia and Han about Aeona intending to steal the Falcon, and eventually a fight between Han, Leia, and Chewie and the Mindorese broke out. Eventually though, Han, Leia, Chewie, and R2 had to retreat out of the Falcon, to which the Mindorese stole the ship and took off.<ref name="SOM" />

Shadowspawn, in reality the former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], Cronal, began preparations to start an [[essence transfer]] into Luke's body, intended to [[Shadow web|recreate Luke's nervous system]] with [[meltmassif]], and using the assistance of forty of his most powerful Pawns, Nick Rostu included as he was worth ten of the other Pawns being Cronal's most powerful Pawn, would use essence transfer to push his consciousness into the recreated nervous system.<ref name="SOM" />

Meanwhile in the space battle, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] had arrived to the battle in the ''[[Remember Alderaan (Star Cruiser)|Remember Alderaan]]'', with [[Fenn Shysa]] and five or six hundred [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Supercommando|supercommandos]]. Destroying the thousands of gravity projectors Cronal had set up in the asteroids surrounding Mindor sped up the time frame of the asteroids crashing into [[Taspan|Mindor's star]]. While for the smaller [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] this wasn't a problem, for the larger asteroids, they could cause the star to start sending flares that would roast all the space forces. Lando gave the command to start descending the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] on the night side of Mindor to shield themselves from the soon coming flares, while they launch empty [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] guarded by three squadrons, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] included, who had arrived late to the battle with Leia Organa in pursuit of Han Solo and Chewbacca, who Leia had sent to the battle due to sensing that Luke was in danger, to draw attention to the escape pods.<ref name="SOM" />

Cronal began the transfer, recreating Luke's nervous system, meanwhile Luke had dreams about the future of his body if Cronal took it over. He was eventually able to awaken in Cronal's body and awake Nick Rostu enough to free him from Cronal's control. Then Cronal was interrupted by Klick, who informed him that a new [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|ship]] had appeared and was making an orbital bombardment on their emplacements, primarily their [[Ion-turbo cannon|ion-turbo cannons]], to presumably make a ground assault. Cronal gave Klick complete command over the situation and ordered him to send some of his best commando's to the Election Center, where Luke was being held, and make sure no Rebel got through. Klick obeyed, and saw to it personally.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:Nick Rostu.jpg|thumb|right|Nick Rostu (pictured) with much difficulty was able to free Luke from the Pawning Table.]]
Nick Rostu, now awakened, ripped off his Shadow Crown so Cronal couldn't take back control of him. Cronal then contacted Klick again to change his orders to shoot whoever tries to come out of the Election Center. Nick, unable to find a liquefier on his person, remembered that a blasters stun blast has a similar charge to a liquefier, necessary to break Luke free from his meltmassif [[Pawning Table]] and so made his way to the door to lure in the troopers guarding outside, bashing one guard and taking his blaster while taking out the other guard. He then made his way back in, dragging an unconscious guard inside and shot a panel to seal the Election Center, as he heard stormtroopers coming. The Pawns, however, stared down Nick. A group blocked Luke's Pawning Table, while another group circled to Nick. Nick, deciding that Luke would try to spare their lives, like how he spared his, and not knowing how the stun blasts could affect the Pawns, shot the meltmassif ground instead, liquefying it and trapping the Pawns there as they scrambled over each other to try and get up. Nick made his way to Luke and used the stun blasts to liquefy the Pawning Table and free him. Nick started to be dragged under by the Pawns, but Luke threw his lightsaber around the room, slashing the Pawns head gear, killing them. Once they were dead, Luke returned the blade to his hand and used the Force to remove all the liquefied meltmassif off his person and from the pools in the room into a sphere in front of him. Luke grieved the deaths of the Pawns, as they were innocents that suffered from Cronal's surgeries to serve his will. When he saw Cronal's mind, he saw Cronal's beliefs of the Dark, and how the only thing permanent was destruction. Luke began to question the purpose of life before Nick snapped him out of his thoughts.<ref name="SOM" />

Meanwhile, Cronal was impressed at Luke's ability to control meltmassif, as Cronal needed to use his Sunset Crown to control the [[Melter|Melter's]] to manipulate meltmassif. Using his [[Darksight]], Cronal was able to sense a very powerful, untrained presence nearby, and was shocked at how he had never considered that Luke wasn't an only child.<ref name="SOM" />

When Klick got to the [[Sorting Center]] he ordered the door to the Election Center to be sealed off. However, Luke, cut through the door with his lightsaber, and left the Election Center with Nick by his side. Klick bowed down to Luke and ordered his men to do so as well, under the impression that Luke was now the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], as Shadowspawn had claimed. Luke was confused, and stopped listening to Klick once he started talking about how much of a masterpiece he found ''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge'' to be. He ordered Klick and his men to take care of the people waiting in the room, treat wounds, feed them, and ordered them to surrender themselves to the New Republic and from now on consider themselves part of the Republic's military.<ref name="SOM" />

Throughout the whole exchange Luke attempted to ward off the truth of the [[Way of the Dark|One Truth]], something he learned when Cronal tried to enter his body, and had to pretend everything he knew before was still reality and hoped that if he pretended it was all still true, perhaps he would believe it was all still true..<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:PrereleaseMindorCoverArt.jpg|thumb|left|Luke Skywalker during the battle.]]
Luke and Nick made their way through the Shadow Base to a ledge, overlooking a caldera. Then the ''Millennium Falcon'' flew overhead, to which Luke assisted it in landing into cinders. Luke and Nick made their way over, and after being attacked by a Mindorese on the Falcon's quad turret, were able to enter where Aeona and Nick reunited. However, the Legions of Shadow found them and started attacking. Luke directed Aeona to drive further down into the cinders, and with some clever things, such as Luke manipulating the [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] from [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] to help push the Falcon in, and Nick shooting the cinders to loosen the Falcon in, the Falcon corkscrewed into the cinders and went down a volcano vent. Luke made his way to the cockpit where he started to pilot the Falcon through the caverns while being chased by TIE's.<ref name="SOM" />

In the caverns, Leia, Han, Chewie, and R2 had all fallen down deeper and were attacked by Melter's, eventually being lead to their [[Melter crypt|crypt]]. Han and Leia fought until they were out of ammo, at which point Chewie was half in the meltmassif, and R2 had overheated. Meanwhile Cronal, using the Sunset Crown to control the body of [[Kar Vastor]], found his way to the crypt where he took Leia and left Han trapped in the meltmassif. Through the caverns, Luke was pursed by the TIE's, however, Nick, who was still in the quad turret, was able to block off the TIE's from getting any closer by collapsing part of the cavern. The problem was that they were at the end of the cavern. After being contacted by C-3PO and Lando Calrissian, Luke learned that the crypt was right above him, so Aeona directed Luke to use the [[antipersonnel field projector]] on the Falcon, a protective measure that stuns people on the Falcon's hull, to melt away the meltmassif and go up. They made their way up, with Han landing on the cockpit, mouthing to Luke that "he" had taken Leia.<ref name="SOM" />

Cronal, in the Cavern of the Shadow Throne and still controlling Kar, took Leia to the Shadow Throne and [[Shadow Egg|encased]] Kar and Leia with meltmassif, by controlling the Melter's, as a measure so they wouldn't be disturbed. Just before he did, however, he contacted a stormtrooper to inform it was time. Then Cronal, still using Kar's body began to lace Leia's nerves with meltmassif so he could begin the transference.<ref name="SOM" />

Luke in the crypt began to communicate with the Melter's, using his own meltmassif laced nerves and learned their history, how they originated from [[Taspan II]] and the [[Big Crush]] brought them to a [[Golden Age of Paradise|Golden Age]], only for many to land on Mindor and begin dying out. Luke saw Leia, albeit as a star moving toward a black hole, and tried to reach out to her, only to realise it was a metaphor. During the whole ordeal, Nick spoke with Aeona, who asked Nick if he was going to tell Luke that the man who attacked Han and Leia was Kar, as the description Han gave lined up. Nick said he wasn't going to, as he knew how dangerous Kar was, and if he told Luke he was another victim of Blackhole, he might go easy and wind up getting killed. Once Luke finished communing with the Melter's, he confronted Nick about who Kar was, telling him he needed to explain in five minutes or less as that's all the time they had. Nick, astonished, realised Luke had sensed his thoughts through the meltmassif.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:True Mandalorians on Korda 6.jpg|thumb|right|The Mandalorian Supercommando's (pictured) alongside Fenn Shysa attacked the Shadow Base, attempting to take out its gravity gun.]]
Within moments of receiving Cronal's order, the Blackhole Stormtrooper triggered a relay that initiated a preprogrammed series of instructions to the crews who manned an array of gravity stations buried deep below Mindor's surface and the Shadow Base in a ring around the base. No one but the troopers assigned to the stations knew about them. They were of the same technology that caused the Big Crush that destroyed [[Taspan II]] only a few years prior. They weren't standard gravity well projectors and instead more like the gravity slice used to destroy the Justice. When the stations were powered up they sent planes of invisible energy through the rock between them beneath the Shadow Base. When the energy intercepted each other they produced gravitational gradient on the order of black holes, instantly consuming the surrounding rock and created a gargantuan blast of extreme hard radiation that turned the surrounding rock into superheated plasma. The radiation created more plasma until it punctured the surface of Mindor and surrounded the Shadow Base, which was immune to becoming plasma as it was constructed from radiation-resistant stone. Something Lando noted as a nifty idea. The plasma around the base grew, with [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], flying with Rogue Squadron, being the first to notice they weren't getting closer to the fireball, the fireball was getting closer to them. Lando also noted, as the Shadow Base began to ascend into orbit, that the base would serve as a shield from the radiation of the solar flares. The plasma killed all who weren't inside the base. However, Fenn Shysa and the Mandalorian Supercommandos, who had arrived with Lando, were inside the Shadow Base attempting to take out the base's gravity gun and ascended with the base. The only thing they noticed was the loss of communication and a deep rumbling vibration alongside a subtle increase in perceived weight, as if everyone had sudden gained a kilo or two. Lando noted that once the Shadow Base was in space, they could direct their STOE's and gravity gun at Mindor with a simple half-barrel roll and open fire randomly, while the Rapid Response Task Force could do nothing about it, as they were in atmosphere, the capital ships hugging vast impact craters, and they had to remain on the night side of the planet to avoid being burned alive by the radiation being sent by Mindor's sun, effectively leaving them trapped.<ref name="SOM" />

Lando, using C-3PO to give the Corellian ships the computing power of the ''Remember Alderaan,'' moved the fleet into a new formation and began barrel rolling so they could keep up fire without needing to pause to recharge one sides cannons. They opened fire on the Shadow Base as it turned around. Mindor's atmosphere rendered the bolts useless, but the intention was to cause enough radiation that the ion-turbo cannons couldn't lock on. This was successful on two cannons, but the other three and gravity gun came into view. The gravity gun opened fire, and one of the ships, ''[[Unsung]]'', was torn apart by the gravity bombs, leaving a breach in formation. However, the remaining interdiction ships used their gravity-wells to slingshot the gravity bombs back at the base. However, the gravity-wells began tearing Mindor's crust apart, causing [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. One of the [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser|CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser's]], ''[[Hold 'Em]]'', accidentally pulled one of the bombs into it, causing it to be ripped into two.<ref name="SOM" />

Lando decided the best chance to survive was to fly into orbit, except the ''Remember Alderaan's'' sensors had already detected a widening gravitic anomaly in Mindor from the crater of the volcano's departure meaning that in two Standard hours, Mindor would be torn apart into asteroids, giving the fleet no protection from Taspan's flares and no escape as the gravity stations were still active. Each impact of the gravity bombs in the planet's surface would shave the time Mindor had until it was destroyed.<ref name="SOM" />

Moving into orbit, the Republic starfighters started flying in a tightening noose to the Shadow Base while the interdiction ships used their gravity-wells to try and drag the gravity bombs away from the starfighters. Lando mused on the deaths of Luke, Leia, Han, Chewie and himself, especially Luke, yet Lando got comfort from the fact that the gravity bombs would destroy the Shadow Base. That was when Luke, in the ''Millennium Falcon'' with Han, Chewie, R2, Nick, Aeona, and the Mindorese, where Luke, taking advantage of Klick's assumption that he was Emperor, ordered the Legions of Shadow to deactivate subspace jamming, power down gravity stations, execute unconditional surrender as fast as possible, and get evacuate non-combatants. He promoted Klick to Air Marshal, and ordered the Republic ships to disengage and withdraw. Lando and Fenn were left in disbelief as the Legions of Shadow complied. Klick led Fenn over to his shadow stormtroopers and explained that the Shadow Base would be destroyed in six minutes.<ref name="SOM" />

===Evacuation and defeating Cronal===
{{Quote|I've been suckered.|Cronal's "final" thought|<ref name="SOM" />}}
The first of the gravity bombs to hit took out two full banks of gravity-drive thrusters and damaged the central coordinating nexus, destablizing the remaining three banks. The stresses began pulling the Shadow Base apart, which only was accelerated with the arrival of the other gravity bombs. The interdiction ships did their best to try and divert the gravity bombs trajectory to no avail.<ref name="SOM" />

Luke, knowing that [[Lancer (freightliner)|''Lancer'']] and ''[[Paleo]]'', converted Corellian freighters, still had some of their original equipment, including a conveyor belt. ''Lancer'' positioned itself beside the Shadow Base and extended its conveyor, with Luke using his new found power to control meltmassif, with the assistance of R2, to open up a wall in the Selection Center to let the prisoners out into the conveyor. The Mandalorian's and shadow stormtroopers assisted the prisoners into the conveyor and made their way onto ''Lancer''. The ''Falcon'' made its way into the Selection Center and let out the Mindorese while Luke ordered the Shadow stormtroopers and Klick into the Falcon.<ref name="SOM" />

Cronal, in the Cavern of the Shadow Throne and still controlling Kar Vastor's body attempted to take over Leia, and while he was able to erase much of what made her who she was, he still was struggling to take her over as while she wasn't fighting him, he was resisting him. No matter what Cronal did he couldn't vanquish Leia, this was made more complicated as Cronal had to be careful to not kill Leia, however, the ball of meltmassif he had constructed around the throne melted when Luke began speaking with Cronal. Luke was intimidated by Vastor's physique but grounded his mind to think what [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan]] would do. Cronal tried bargaining with Luke that he'd let Leia go if Luke gave himself over for Cronal to take, however, Luke rejected this and explained that Nick was currently on his way to the asteroid that Cronal was hiding on with Aeona, using the shuttle that Cronal had intended to use to escape the Shadow Base, to kill Cronal's real body. Luke gave Cronal the option to fight Luke and die or flee. Cronal then lifted Leia's body and claimed that both Leia and Luke could die, so Luke jumped over and struck the meltmassif. Cronal gathered that Luke missed but realized that Luke had struck the repulsor lift holding up the Shadow Throne and its platform. The platform fell and landed on the ''Millennium Falcon'' below, where Luke had gotten into the cavern in the first place and hiked up. Luke handed Leia to Chewie who took her inside where Luke explained that Leia wasn't alright, while Klick and his troopers appeared on the ledge above, where Klick explained his orders that he was to not let the Vastor body harm the ship, Luke or Leia.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:Luke_Skywalker_and_the_Shadows_of_Mindor.jpg|thumb|left|Luke tackled with Kar Vastor, on top of the ''Millennium Falcon''.]]
Cronal figured he failed because he, without realizing, went against the Way of the Dark and created rather than destroyed. He then asked Luke to answer why the armor of his troopers was black. Luke never questioned it, assuming it was a style choice, before realizing it was meltmassif. Leia, Klick, the shadow stormtroopers, and Kar Vastor began writhing and twisting in slow-motion. Then Kar, free from Cronal's control sprang to his feet, grabbed Luke's shoulders and started biting his neck. As it turned out the inside of the shadow stormtroopers armor had turned to needles and had spiked into their bodies, including their brain, leaving them with nothing but a burning need to kill.<ref name="SOM" />

Nick Rostu, with Aeona Cantor were approaching Cronal's asteroid before he entered hyperspace on no particular route and turned on the gravity wells again, trapping the Republic in the Taspan system again to let them burn. Nick observed the heavy armoring of the shuttle and stated that only he and Aeona would survive the flares. Han went to help Luke on top of the Falcon, however, he knew he couldn't fire lethal bolts as Luke might get hit, and stun blasts didn't work on Vastor, but his blaster was snatched out of his hand by the Force, so he took a large rock of obsidian and charged at Vastor, leaping at him. However, a bolt from his blaster destroyed the rock and he fell on his back. Luke, holding the blaster still being held by Kar told Han that he had already told Han to go. Vastor released Luke, to Han it seemed like Vastor was the one who was scared and in trouble, and Kar leapt off the Falcon. Luke and Han had a small exchange about how Luke knew Han would've killed Vastor and he had to scare him off as he wasn't intent on killing anyone else. He handed Han his blaster, as they had noticed the screaming from the troopers had stopped. Shortly after they started to attack the Falcon, leaping down onto it and opening fire. Luke covered Han and encouraged him to go, explaining that he was going after Vastor and that Leia would need Han. After Han refused, Luke used the Force to close the Falcon's hatch, and after realising these troopers were more than capable of breaking the hatches seal, Han returned to the cockpit and set off to leave the Shadow Base. However, R2 ejected himself out the trash ejector without Han or Chewie knowing, so he could try to help Luke.<ref name="SOM" />

TIE Interceptors started another attack on the New Republic ships, destroying the ''Wait a Minute'' and killing Captain [[Jav Patrell|Patrell]]. Inside the ''Lancer'', the shadow stormtroopers aboard began attacking, and although the Mandalorians were able to seize some weapons from them during their writhing, they couldn't take all of them in time, and a battle between them waged on, with over a thousand prisoners without military experience dying at the stormtroopers hands.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:KarVastor.jpg|thumb|right|Kar Vastor (pictured) cowered in the Election Center, terrified of Luke who had pulled out meltmassif from Vastor's body.]]
Kar Vastor had retreated to the Election Center, afraid of Luke as he had pulled meltmassif out of Vastor's mouth and hand during their grapple. Luke introduced himself and was able to calm Vastor as well as getting him to trust him so he could take on Cronal. Through Vastor, Luke used Vastor's connection with Cronal to interact with Cronal. Cronal had put the Shadow Crown on his head to control the meltmassif and open the viewport of his life-support chamber so he could look into hyperspace, however, through Vastor, Luke could connect to Cronal, through Cronal, Luke could connect to the Shadow Crown, and use it to melt away the meltmassif that inhabitted everyone. Cronal attempted to remove the Shadow Crown, but Luke released Cronal's own meltmassif and encased him in it, and then melted away his asteroid. The hyperdrive had been attached to the asteroid, not the chamber so that fell away, leaving Cronal exposed to hyperspace without the hyperdrives protective envelop of reality, leading to him and his chamber to dissolve away. Luke knew that by releasing the meltmassif from the stormtroopers bodies, it would activate their deadman interlock, and so stayed with them as thousands of them died. This spelled the end for the Legions of Shadow.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:Leia-DarkApprentice.jpg|thumb|left|Han Solo and Leia Organa (pictured) shared what they thought would be their final meal on Mindor's surface.]]
Han had landed back on Mindor, having learned about the gravity stations being turned back on, and sat with Leia outside the Falcon as she had begged for light. Leia eventually woke up, free from the meltmassif thanks to Lukr and she and Han had a picnic, using the dead stormtroopers stale ration packs, hoping to watch the sun rise one last time. As they went to kiss, Chewbacca called to them, telling them that the gravity wells were now turned off and they could escape, to which they did.<ref name="SOM" />

Taspan's flares destroyed all of the gravity stations which now free were from the meltmassif, the Shadow Base entered it's final break up, and Mindor was destroyed under the flares as well. With the mass-shadows now absent from the destroyed gravity stations, the New Republic ships jumped to hyperspace. Kar and Luke, free from the meltmassif themselves, spoke about how the Election Center was a bad place to die. Kar told Luke that he wouldn't be glad to die with a Jedi, but he was glad that he'd die with Luke as unlike other Jedi he wasn't afraid of the dark. Nick and Aeona made their way to the Election Center and rescued Luke. On the shuttle, Luke asked Nick about an investigator to bring the story of the Battle of Mindor to, and Nick suggested [[Lorz Geptun]]. R2 saw the shuttle and sent out a distress beacon code.<ref name="SOM" />

On the shuttle, shortly before Nick left, Nick asked Luke what his best trick was. Luke told him that he had just seen it. To do one small simple move and kill thousands.<ref name="SOM" />

===Aftermath===
{{Quote|Let them tell their stories. Let them make holothrillers and whatever else. It doesn't matter. None of the stories people tell about me can change who I really am."<br>"Yes. But they can change who people ''think'' you are. And that, my young friend, can do considerable damage. Look at ''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge''."<br>"I guess... I guess if people are going to tell stories about me anyway, I should make sure they're telling the right kind of stories.|Luke Skywalker and Lorz Geptun|<ref name="SOM" />}}
After the Battle of Mindor, Luke requested Lorz Geptun's presence so he could question the survivors of the battle and write up a case for Luke to be charged with. What he winded up writing up infuriated Luke as it was a largely fictional story that wasn't close to the real events. Luke, after calming down and saying that the stories people write about him don't change who he is, requested Lorz to rewrite the story and make it more faithful.<ref name="SOM" />

[[File:Perek2.jpg|thumb|right|Lord Cronal survived the Battle of Mindor and after fleeing to Andoweel Lord Cronal took on his supposed birthname, Perek.]]
While he was speaking with Geptun about the revisions, Luke brought up that Nick and Kar still believed Cronal survived and that they had a score to settle with him. Luke mused that if Cronal was still alive, he wouldn't have much time to stir up any mischief as Nick, Kar, and Aeona would be on his tail.<ref name="SOM" /> As it turned out Nick and Kar were right as Cronal had indeed survived through means not entirely certain. The most likely possibility proposed being that his spirit was summoned from [[Chaos/Legends|Chaos]] by necromancing [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomiri]] shamans, or even [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], among many proposed possibilities. Either way Cronal survived.<ref name="Imperial">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref> Despite Luke's assumption that Nick, Kar and Aeona would keep Cronal busy and stop him from stirring up mischief,<ref name="SOM" /> Cronal found his way to [[Trailia]] and started experimenting on the [[Trailian|Trailians]].<ref name="screen" /> 
{{RPG}}
But a group faced Cronal and despite being a tough opponent, Cronal winded up fleeing.<ref name="screen">{{WEGCite|story=The Monster Maker|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}
Cronal took some of his Trailians with him that eventually perished in another experiment he attempted.<ref name="Imperial" /> He eventually retreated to [[Andooweel/Legends|Andoweel]] after the death of his Trailian experiments, and reinvented himself as the cyber-artist "Perek". "Perek" supposedly being his pre-Rhandite birthname.<ref name="Imperial" /> However, Perek met his final death<ref name="CNE">''[[Collapsing New Empires|"Collapsing New Empires" —]] [[Star Wars Tales 19]]''</ref> on Andoweel<ref name="Imperial" /> when facing Luke Skywalker when his [[Mechu-deru|Mechu-Deru]] turned against him.<ref name="Imperial" /><ref name="CNE" />

==Government and military==
===Lord of the Shadow Throne===
{{Quote|I have done what the vain, arrogant Emperor and his pathetic hound Vader never could! I have defeated Luke Skywalker!|Lord Shadowspawn|<ref name="SOM" />}}
[[File:BlackholeTEAbyTrevas.jpg|thumb|left|Lord of the Shadow Throne, Lord Shadowspawn, as depicted through a Pawn.]]
The Legions of Shadow was headed by the Lord of the Shadow Throne. This position was only ever held by Lord Shadowspawn, a persona created by Cronal, who's physical presence was often the presence of a Pawn. However, when communing with his troopers purely through his voice, as was often the case, Cronal would use a voice modulator, giving his voice a liquid basso, replicating Shadowspawn's voice. Cronal eventually hoped to take over Luke Skywalker's body and use Skywalker's body to reign the Empire as the "rightful" claim to the throne, as the holothriller he had made, ''Luke Skywalker and the Jedi's Revenge'', made it seem as if Luke had avenged Palpatine's death by killing Darth Vader, and was chosen by Palpatine to be his successor. However, after Luke escaped his grasp, he found Leia and hoped to take her over instead, yet she proved incredibly difficult to take over despite the fact she wasn't fighting back. He winded up failing and had to escape the Mindor system in his original body. For which he was thankful that his original powers remained intact.<ref name="SOM" />

===Pawns===
{{Quote|Listen-that headgear. You gotta understand. It's a device-a machine-Sith alchemy-"<br>"There really is such a thing as Sith alchemy? That wasn't part of the act?"<br>"Look at my head, Skywalker. That blood look like an act to you? There are... crystals implanted in my brain. That headgear concentrates the Dark-what you call the Force--so that Cronal... Blackhole... can use me like a puppet He can see through my eyes, hear with my ears... The more Force-touch you have, the more he can do with you. That's why he made me into Shadowspawn...|Nick Rostu and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SOM" />}}
Lord Shadowspawn made use of Pawns, chosen Force-sensitive individuals to have surgery so that they may be forced to wear a head gear. The surgery would lace their brains with meltmassif, with additional meltmassif being inside the head gear. Then once the surgery was complete, Cronal would control them with his own device, the Sunset Crown, a head gear imbued with Sith alchemy. Cronal would be able to see and hear what the Pawns could see and hear, with even their hands and mouths being under Cronal's control thanks to him being able to control the meltmassif lacing their bodies through the Sunset Crown. The Pawns typically made use of holomasks that were projected from the head gear, to make it seem as if it was actually Lord Shadowspawn's face. The head gear had a dead man's interlock to kill the Pawn should their head gear be removed. However, the dead man's interlock could be damaged, such as when Luke punched Nick Rostu and damaged the dead man's interlock, making the interlock fail when Luke and later Nick ripped off the head gear. If they removed the head gear and survived, a Pawns memory of being under Cronal's influence would be a bit hazy but there. They had command over the Legions of Shadow as they essentially were Cronal, though only the Pawns themselves knew this. The Pawn hierarchy confused Klick, a Group Captain [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], as one moment a Pawn would be commanding subordinate Pawns, and then the next, the Pawn would be taking commands from those same subordinates. He assumed it must've had something to do with the Force, something Luke Skywalker picked up on when a Pawn gave a command. In reality there was no hierarchy, as it was all just Cronal controlling them through the Sunset Crown. The most powerful Pawn was Nick Rostu, who was ten times worth the other thirty nine most powerful Pawns.<ref name="SOM" />

===Military and marines===
{{Quote|My legions are bred to absolute obedience. They will obey my command until their deaths, or my own... when they will serve the command of Luke Skywalker, instead.|Lord Shadowspawn to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="SOM" />}}
[[File:Blackholetrooper-RAH.png|thumb|right|Cronal's personal troopers, the Blackhole stormtroopers made up the Legions military.]]
For ground combat, Shadowspawn made use of his personal Blackhole stormtroopers. The Blackhole Stormtroopers wore [[stygium armor]], allowing them to record things. Something Cronal used to rewatch Luke and Shadowspawn's battle in the Cavern of the Shadow Throne to try and mimick Luke's voice. Additionally, by the time of the Legions of Shadow's formation it was black due to the meltmassif on the armor, which had meltmassif needles that could stab into the trooper at Cronal's command, being able to cut away at their body and brain, leaving them with only a burning need to kill someone. The armor also contained a dead man's interlock that would activate if the meltmassif melted away, killing the trooper.<ref name="SOM" />

Additionally, the Legions of Shadow appeared to have no traditional [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], with its officers being made up by Blackhole stormtroopers, such as Group Captain Klick, later promoted to Air Marshal by Luke Skywalker.<ref name="SOM" />

For air and space combat Shadowspawn made use of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] which were common place in his forces with TIE Bombers being used as well.<ref name="SOM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Legions of Shadow were first mentioned, though unnamed, in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''. Simply being referred to as an Imperial faction that served Lord Shadowspawn.<ref name="DES">[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]</ref> Shadowspawn's faction would continue to get mentioned, with connections eventually being made to the Battle of Mindor.<ref name="TNEC">[[The New Essential Chronology]]</ref> Eventually Shadowspawn's faction was identified as the Legions of Shadow<ref name="SOM" /> at the end of December [[2008]]<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=82866|text=Matthew Stover}}</ref> in the novel [[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor|''Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor'']], which told the story of the Battle of Mindor. Though the novel implies that only the Briefing and Debriefing were true events, as the Debriefing implies that the rest of the book was an exaggerated, fictional retelling of events.<ref name="SOM" />

Blackhole and Shadowspawn being one in the same was not clarified until a few weeks before Shadows of Mindor's release when the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia|Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' released. In Blackhole's entry it was confirmed that he and Shadowspawn were one in the same.<ref name="TCSWE">[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]</ref>
